title: A crew command that ran, run with --json

command.description: The command that ran, for example `crew halt` or `retire`.

notes.description: The lines the text mode prints on stderr, without the `tares factory: ` prefix. For a person, not for parsing.

left_to_watch.description: `crew update` only, and only when it left stations out: the stations a person had open in a terminal. It did not wait for them; the watch moves them when they are free.
